name: Death Game 2: Survive & Love
source:
Death Game 2: Survive & Love is a choice-based suspense romance visual novel where six characters are trapped in a mansion and one must die every three days. Your choices decide who survives and which ending you reach.

The death game that should have ended begins again.

The survivors of the previous game have returned to ordinary lives, but none of them ever truly escaped what happened. Then one day, the protagonist receives a USB drive. Inside is a message from the masked Game Master.

"It isn't over. You have been chosen to proceed to the next stage."

A hidden address on the drive leads to a massive mansion. The protagonist arrives, and consciousness fades.

Waking up, three familiar faces are waiting: Kamiko, Hannah, and Maddie. Two strangers, Isabelle and Noah, are there as well. Then a voice echoes through the halls.

"Here, you will face your sins."

The rules are simple. Every three days, one person must be chosen as a sacrifice, and the chosen one is executed.

As the group searches the mansion for a way out, they uncover hidden rooms and secrets tied to everyone's past. Why were they brought back? Who controls the game? And what do their sins have to do with this place?

Fear spreads faster than answers, and trusting the person beside you gets harder with every passing day.

After two deaths, the mastermind finally reveals himself and presents the final trial: the Door of Salvation. If someone willingly gives up their life, the rest go free. If no one volunteers, the group must choose who dies.

Who survives, who is sacrificed, and whether you save yourself or someone else is entirely up to you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.gamedeath&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
